description: One suggested item from one duplicate check. Child of Item Match Log.

fields.description: cat_no = found by an exact Cat No lookup (Step 0). name = found and scored by name.
fields.label: Found Via

fields.description: The human sentence the user was shown, e.g. "names 97% alike - same manufacturer (thermo) - both 50 mL".
fields.label: Why It Matched

fields.description: Which safety rule cancelled this pair, if any. Set means the pair was NOT offered to the user however alike the names were.
fields.label: Why It Was Cancelled

fields.description: The suggested item is disabled. Still a valid answer to "does this already exist", but it ranks below live items.
fields.label: Suggested Item Is Disabled

fields.description: Carried for the reviewer only. Description is never scored: 80.9% of them are a near-copy of the item name.
fields.label: Item Description (display only)

fields.description: Per-component breakdown as JSON, so a logged decision can be re-derived exactly: ordered, word_set, length_penalty, rare, makes, raw_score.
fields.label: Component Scores
